decisions.reason: The plural instruction applies to Unit 1, but its complete same-message MODIFY already records the drain-safe toilet-positioning constraint.
The plural instruction applies to Unit 2, but its complete same-message MODIFY already records both the toilet-positioning constraint and the separate Unit 2 door change.
The project-wide drainage effect is already fully represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY.
Updating toilet positions relative to existing drains does not necessarily change Unit 3's bathroom-door position or kitchen-counter clearance constraint.
The source changes bathroom toilet positioning, not Unit 3's kitchen placement or its clearance from the bathroom door.
The drain-safe toilet-positioning instruction does not entail any change to partition walls.
The source does not change Unit 1's kitchen configuration, cabinet dimensions, or cabinet placement.
The source does not change Unit 2's kitchen configuration, cabinet dimensions, or cabinet placement.
Bathroom toilet positioning has no entailed effect on common or independent entrance-door requirements.
The source leaves the dwelling count and Unit 1 room configuration unchanged.
Adjusting toilet fixture positions to accommodate drains does not reassign the WC area or alter its Unit 1 allocation.
The task-local initial concept sketch remains historically valid; later fixture-position revisions do not modify that initial artifact requirement.
